title: ArtonaClearLag
description: Artona ClearLag – Fully Configurable Entity & Item Cleaner for Paper/Spigot/Bukkit/Purpur
body:
Artona ClearLag is the ultimate **server optimization tool** for Paper, Spigot, Bukkit, and Purpur 1.21.x servers. Say goodbye to lag caused by dropped items, mobs, and miscellaneous entities!

**Features:**    
✅ Fully configurable ClearLag intervals and countdowns

✅ Support for **entity and item blacklist** – never remove what you want to keep

✅ Countdown messages and optional sound effects for players

✅ Discord webhook notifications – keep your staff informed in real time

✅ Compatible with Paper, Spigot, Bukkit, and Purpur 1.21.x

✅ Reloadable configuration with 
**/artonacl reload** command

**Why choose Artona ClearLag?**
Saves server resources and reduces lag instantly

Fully customizable – control exactly what is removed and what is kept

Easy setup – just drop the plugin into your server

Provides real-time feedback to players and staff

**Installation:**
Download the latest Artona ClearLag .jar

Place it in your server's plugins folder

Start or reload your server to generate **config.yml**

Edit the config to set intervals, messages, sounds, and blacklisted items

Enjoy a lag-free server experience!

**Recommended for:**

PvP, survival, and minigame servers

Large servers with lots of items and mobs

Server admins looking to **automatically manage entities and keep lag under control**

**Changelog:**  
**v1.0.0** – Initial release with full English config, countdown timer, blacklist support, Discord webhook, and Paper/Bukkit/Spigot/Purpur compatibility
